hooks.command: node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const t=JSON.parse(s);if(((t.tool_input&&t.tool_input.command)||'').includes('git commit'))process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PostToolUse',additionalContext:'DOC SWEEP REMINDER: a git commit just ran. Before continuing, check whether this change made any docs stale (README.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/README.md, supabase/README.md, and relevant files under docs/specs and docs/plans) and update them this same session. Skip only if the commit was docs-only or clearly has no documentation impact.'}}))}catch(e){}})"
